features_shell_tool.label: Shell Tool
features_shell_tool.help: Enable shell tool, allowing execution of shell commands.

features_subagents.label: Subagents
features_subagents.help: Enable subagent delegation and fan-out functionality.

features_web_search.label: Web Search
features_web_search.help: Enable web search and compatible alias web.run, using DuckDuckGo by default.

features_apply_patch.label: Apply Patch
features_apply_patch.help: Enable apply_patch tool, supporting unified diff format for batch modifications.

features_mcp.label: MCP
features_mcp.help: Enable Model Context Protocol support, allowing connection to external MCP servers to extend the toolset.

features_exec_policy.label: Exec Policy
features_exec_policy.help: Enable execution policy engine, performing permission checks and approval on tool calls.

features_vision_model.label: Vision Model
features_vision_model.help: Needs to be manually enabled. After enabling, an independent image analysis model (such as Xiaomi MiMo) can be configured via [vision_model].
